authority: Owner: Then fix the eagle. Redo it entirely. Existing Meshy licence and inspected project-authored reference workflow authorized.
generation: Single inspected-image-to-3D submission on the existing licence. No purchase, text-only generation or roster addition.
source: model.glb is the unmodified downloaded Meshy source; submission.json records the inspected reference hash and settings.
preparation: prepare_galecrest.py uses measured bird landmarks, preserves source UV/material, reduces to 29048 triangles and authors the existing six-clip contract on a 19-bone rig. The rebuild preserves the established 3.5m runtime height, footprint and collider parameters.
colourways: prepare_colourways.py --source <installed GLB> --out <output folder> rasterizes the new UV mesh and skin influences. Ordinary source pixels remain unchanged; shiny and alpha use smooth anatomical masks. Whole face and feet preserve source detail. Legacy atlas and rust-based rules retired.
portrait: Blender CPU Cycles rendering of the replacement model through the existing render_portrait.py pipeline at 512px, 24 samples; no reference image pasted into runtime UI.
limits: Native Windows Compatibility frames support appearance; still samples do not prove continuous animation or ROG Ally performance. Cloudreach environmental Bars A/B and F08#4 are separate open acceptance work. See current visual verdict, including failures, in the evidence folder.

archived_candidate.disposition: Superseded pre-faint-revision checkpoint, NOT the installed/accepted model. Preserved for the owner all-work consolidation request. Its hash matches old_sha256 in the committed export-equality evidence. Asset source directory is excluded from engine import by .gdignore.
archived_candidate.capture_wrappers: scratch-capture-clips.gd and scratch-capture-world.gd preserve the original temporary overrides verbatim. Historical paths point to the former scratch export and are not production commands. Current installed validation uses the committed capture-final-world.gd / capture-variants.gd and tools/art_pipeline/capture_creature_clips.gd.
